title: cystopteris fragilis var. tenuis
intro: Cystopteris fragilis var. tenuis, commonly known as slender brittle fern, is a variety of fern plant that belongs to the family Cystopteridaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it a therapeutic agent for various health issues. The bioactive constituents of Cystopteris fragilis var. tenuis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The plant has been used to treat various conditions, including respiratory issues, wounds, and skin problems, due to its ability to promote wound healing and reduce oxidative stress.
